//: Copy to config.json and keep only the keys you want to change. Everything else falls back to defaults.json.
//teams: Optional. Without this, one pod per department. With it, agents are grouped into named pods by a regex on the task id.
//roles: Optional. First keyword found in the task id wins; otherwise the task name is used as the job title.
//nameOverrides: Pin a person's name by task id instead of letting it be assigned.
//hermes: Optional: read a Hermes agent over SSH (docker exec). Leave disabled unless you run one.
